item.title: Nobody wants to buy Microsoft Office, but everyone eventually needs it — Now $33
item.description:
Source: PCWorld Pre-analysis score: 0.84
TL;DR: Microsoft Office Professional 2021 for Windows includes Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and more in a one-time purchase, with no Microsoft 365 subscription required, on sale for $32.97 (reg. $219.99) through September 27. Office is one of those programs nobody gets excited to open, but skipping it isn’t really an option once a client wants a Word doc or a boss wants a spreadsheet. Luckily, you can just buy Microsoft Office Professional 2021 once and be done with it. Office Pro 2021 is on sale for $32.97 (reg. $219.99) through September 27. Microsoft 365 renews every year at full price no matter how often Word or Excel get opened, and canceling it means losing access to the desktop apps. This license skips that cycle entirely, installing once on one Windows PC and continuing to work without a recurring bill. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams in its free version, OneNote, Publisher, and Access all come with the suite. These are the apps that most home and small-business setups rely on day-to-day. Windows 10 and 11 both support installation, though Windows 7 and 8 don’t. The license isn’t compatible with Parallels or other virtual machines — it requires a physical Windows PC rather than a Mac running Windows software. Skip renewing Microsoft 365 — Through September 27, get Microsoft Office Professional 2021 on sale for $32.97.
